    Track = e + a + j + x and
    Signal = s1 + s2 and
    succs = e -> a + e -> j + a -> j + j -> x and
    signals = e -> s1 + e -> s2 and
    Junction = j and
    Entry = e and
    Exit = x and
    Semaphore = s2 and
    Speed = s1
} for 4 Track, 2 Signal

run {
  some disj e1, e2, j1, m, j2, x : Track | some disj s1, s2, s3, s4 : Signal |
    Track = e1 + e2 + j1 + m + j2 + x and
    Signal = s1 + s2 + s3 + s4 and
    succs = e1 -> j1 + e2 -> j1 + j1 -> m + m -> j2 + e2 -> j2 + j2 -> x and
    signals = e1 -> s1 + e1 -> s2 + e2 -> s3 + e2 -> s4 and
    Junction = j1 + j2 and
    Entry = e1 + e2 and
    Exit = x and
    Semaphore = s2 + s4 and
    Speed = s1 + s3
} for 6 Track, 4 Signal

run pos1 {
  some disj p1, p2 : Person, disj c1 : Course, disj pr1 : Project, disj g1, g2 : Grade |
    Person = p1 + p2
    Professor = p1
    Student = p2
    Course = c1
    Project = pr1
    Grade = g1 + g2
    Grade <: next = g1->g2
    Person <: teaches = p1->c1
    Person <: enrolled = p2->c1
    Person <: projects = p2->pr1
    Course <: projects = c1->pr1
    grades = none->none->none
} for 2 Person, 1 Course, 1 Project, 2 Grade expect 1

run pos2 {

    Person <: projects = p2->pr1 + p3->pr1 + p3->pr2
    Course <: projects = c1->pr1 + c1->pr2

} for 3 Person, 1 Course, 2 Project, 2 Grade expect 1
